sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_url" TEXT, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok', "signature" TEXT, "provider_config" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mailboxes" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT, "category" TEXT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "parent_id" TEXT, "color" INTEGER, "unread_threads" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_threads" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, PRIMARY KEY(account_id, id)) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "from_addr" TEXT, "to_addrs" TEXT, "cc_addrs" TEXT, "bcc_addrs" TEXT, "reply_to_addrs" TEXT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snippet" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, "is_flagged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "is_draft" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "has_attachments" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "attachments" TEXT, "message_id_header" TEXT, "in_reply_to" TEXT, "refs" TEXT, "list_unsubscribe" TEXT, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(account_id, id));
CREATE INDEX messages_by_thread ON messages (account_id, thread_id, date)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_mailboxes" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mailbox_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id, message_id, mailbox_id), FOREIGN KEY(account_id, message_id)REFERENCES messages(account_id, id)ON DELETE CASCADE) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX message_mailboxes_by_mailbox ON message_mailboxes (account_id, mailbox_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "threads" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "snippet" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "message_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unread_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "flagged" INTEGER NOT NULL, "has_attachments" INTEGER NOT NULL, "draft_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "participants" TEXT NOT NULL, "mailbox_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id, id)) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX threads_active ON threads (account_id, last_date DESC, id) WHERE active_count > 0
CREATE INDEX threads_flagged ON threads (account_id, last_date DESC, id) WHERE flagged = 1 AND active_count > 0

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "thread_mailboxes" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mailbox_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unread" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id, thread_id, mailbox_id), FOREIGN KEY(account_id, thread_id)REFERENCES threads(account_id, id)ON DELETE CASCADE) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX thread_mailboxes_list ON thread_mailboxes (account_id, mailbox_id, last_date DESC, thread_id)
CREATE INDEX thread_mailboxes_unread ON thread_mailboxes (account_id, mailbox_id) WHERE unread = 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bodies" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "html" TEXT, "plain" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(account_id, message_id), FOREIGN KEY(account_id, message_id)REFERENCES messages(account_id, id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_parts" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id, message_id, content_id), FOREIGN KEY(account_id, message_id)REFERENCES bodies(account_id, message_id)ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contacts" ("email" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT, "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX contacts_rank ON contacts (use_count DESC, last_used DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id, "key")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_ops" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT, "not_before" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX pending_ops_by_account ON pending_ops (account_id, id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "send_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX outbox_by_account ON outbox (account_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_fts" USING fts5(subject, sender, recipients, snippet, body, content = '', contentless_delete = 1, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix = '2 3');
